name: genetiq
description: Genetiq — a WebGPU 3D engine for exploring, mutating, and generatively reimagining genomes.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @genetiq/core build && pnpm --filter @genetiq/api build && pnpm --filter @genetiq/web build
scripts.dev: pnpm build:core && concurrently -n core,api,web -c magenta,blue,green "pnpm --filter @genetiq/core dev" "pnpm --filter @genetiq/api dev" "pnpm --filter @genetiq/web dev"
scripts.clean: pnpm -r exec rm -rf dist node_modules/.cache && rm -rf node_modules
